researchId.title: Research ID
researchId.description: The off-core research job ID for the previously generated plan. If not provided, the action retrieves it from the current Knowledge Space session.

deepResearchWorkflowAction.title: Deep Research Workflow Action
deepResearchWorkflowAction.description: Workflow action identifier — must be RUN_RESEARCH for this action. Set by the LEX client when the user clicks Run Research on the plan card.
